user.title: WuyeBao
user.description:
Enter your WuyeBao account.

The "API base URL" must be obtained from a packet capture of your own app / mini-program (e.g. https://api.example.com). See the capture guide.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: The WuyeBao login expired or the password changed. Please re-enter your credentials.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the server. Check the URL, the network, and that the captured address is correct
error.invalid_auth: Login failed: wrong phone or password. If the URL is correct, the login endpoint may differ — adjust the paths in Options against your capture
error.unknown: Unknown error, see the Home Assistant log

init.title: WuyeBao options
init.description: Paths and fields must match what you captured. Defaults work with many common platforms.
